diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
index cead45386f6..e2b36e982be 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/manifests/thunderbird_candidates.yml
@@ -47,6 +47,7 @@ tasktype_map:
     repackage-signing-shippable-l10n-msix: signing
     release-sign-and-push-langpacks: scriptworker
     release-deb-repackage: repackage
+    repackage-deb-l10n: repackage
 platform_names:
     path_platform:
         by-platform:
@@ -195,6 +196,21 @@ mapping:
         checksums_path: ${path_platform}/xpi/${locale}.xpi
         destinations:
             - ${version}-candidates/build${build_number}/${path_platform}/xpi
+    target.langpack.deb:
+        <<: *default
+        all_locales: true
+        description: "langpack.xpi repackaged as a .deb"
+        locale_prefix: ''
+        from:
+            - repackage-deb-l10n
+        only_for_platforms:
+            - linux-shippable
+            - linux64-shippable
+        pretty_name: ${locale}.deb
+        checksums_path: ${path_platform}/deb-l10n/${locale}.deb
+        destinations:
+            - ${version}-candidates/build${build_number}/${path_platform}/deb-l10n
+        update_balrog_manifest: false
     mar:
         <<: *default
         description: "Alongside `mbsdiff`, a tool used to generate partials"

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-deb-l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-deb-l10n/kind.yml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..a455271593d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-deb-l10n/kind.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+# License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+# file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+---
+loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
+
+transforms:
+    - taskgraph.transforms.from_deps
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage_l10n
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.name_sanity
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage_routes
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task
+
+kind-dependencies:
+    - shippable-l10n
+
+only-for-build-platforms:
+    # Langpacks support all CPU architectures. We just need to pick one
+    - linux64-shippable/opt
+
+tasks:
+    repackage-deb-l10n:
+        from-deps:
+            group-by: single-with-filters
+        worker-type: b-linux-gcp
+        worker:
+            docker-image: {"in-tree": "debian12-repackage"}
+            max-run-time: 600
+        mozharness:
+            run-as-root: true
+            use-caches: false
+            comm-checkout: true
+            config-paths:
+                - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
+            config:
+                by-build-platform:
+                    linux64\b.*:
+                        - repackage/base.py
+                        - repackage/linux64_signed.py
+        package-formats:
+            by-build-platform:
+                linux.*: [deb-l10n]
+        treeherder-group: Deb-l10n
diff --git a/testing/mozharness/configs/repackage/base.py b/testing/mozharness/configs/repackage/base.py
index 2c23ddbb7fd..f3826fa824a 100644
--- a/testing/mozharness/configs/repackage/base.py
+++ b/testing/mozharness/configs/repackage/base.py
@@ -15,4 +15,5 @@ config = {
     "rpm-templates": "",
     "wsx-stub": "comm/mail/installer/windows/msi/installer.wxs",
     "fetch-dir": os.environ.get("MOZ_FETCHES_DIR"),
+    "extensions-dir": "thunderbird/distribution/extensions",
 }
diff --git a/testing/mozharness/configs/repackage/linux64_signed.py b/testing/mozharness/configs/repackage/linux64_signed.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..d1431456c00
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/mozharness/configs/repackage/linux64_signed.py
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+# License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+# file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+
+import os
+
+platform = "linux64"
+
+config = {
+    "locale": os.environ.get("LOCALE"),
+    # ToolTool
+    "tooltool_cache": os.environ.get("TOOLTOOL_CACHE"),
+    "run_configure": False,
+}
